goal: jobs.pilot.package binds every snapshot to the vendored test files under deployment/bnl/jobs (test_*.py), which never run on the cluster. A test-only re-vendor therefore made every deployed profile stale, and a trial session had to repackage and redeploy mid-acceptance. Change packaging so the vendored tests are not part of a package, keeping everything else it packages. The acceptance test test_vendored_tests_are_not_packaged in jobs/test_pilot.py states the decision.
